parsed.rationale: Both participating records reside in test targets: `Shared/AppServices/Tests/AppServicesTests/NowPlayingServiceTests.swift` and `Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkServiceTests.swift`. The near-duplicate signal (Jaccard 0.75) is between two `MockArtworkService` types that exist solely to support their respective test suites. Consolidating test mocks across package boundaries would couple `AppServicesTests` to `ArtworkTests` (or vice versa), introducing an undesirable cross-test-package dependency. The duplication is intentional fixture mirroring and should be left in place.
